name: Hermes Call Relay
description: Self-hosted relay for Hermes Call: end-to-end encrypted signaling rendezvous, TURN media relay (ciphertext only) and Apple VoIP push, so a home Hermes Agent can call an iPhone without any inbound port at home.

notes.text: Forward only TCP 443, TCP/UDP 3478 and UDP 49160-49200 from your router to this container. Never forward anything to the Hermes container.
Apple VoIP push is configured after install: copy your .p8 key in with `pct push` and run `/opt/hermes-call/relay/install.sh install --apns-key ...` (see docs).
Create a one-time bridge pairing code with `hermescall-relay pair`.
